name: anudeep-khadi-bandar-billing
description: feat(core): absolute local invoice resilience, native mobile view enhancements, and host WhatsApp bot cloud synchronization
releaseNotes: 1. Invoices generated locally can NEVER disappear from Invoice History or Dashboard regardless of cloud sync timing or poll ticks. 2. WhatsApp bot status is synchronized in real-time to Supabase Cloud so web portal always displays accurate connection state. 3. Prevented opening manual WhatsApp browser tabs upon sending receipts. 4. Enhanced mobile layout for Parties and Reports with smooth auto-scroll to top and full responsive entry cards.
